description: Partner pack for Polygon — PoS chain + Polygon zkEVM + AggLayer for cross-chain liquidity. Biases toward consumer-scale dApps, NFTs, and payments where low fees + Ethereum compatibility matter more than raw throughput.

defaults.headline: Ship on Polygon — consumer-scale EVM with AggLayer
defaults.subheadline: PoS + zkEVM + AggLayer. Low fees, wide wallet support, cross-chain composability.

buildHints.whenToUse: Prompt mentions Polygon, MATIC, zkEVM, NFT drop, consumer-scale dApp, or payments rail needing sub-cent gas.
firstSteps: Polygon PoS chainId 137 (mainnet) / 80002 (Amoy testnet). Polygon zkEVM chainId 1101 / 2442 (Cardona testnet).
Decide PoS vs zkEVM early: PoS = widest liquidity + cheapest gas; zkEVM = Ethereum security + higher composability with L1.
Bridge via the official Polygon Portal (portal.polygon.technology) for PoS ↔ Ethereum. For AggLayer cross-chain messaging, see docs.polygon.technology/agglayer.
gotchas: PoS reorgs happen — Polygon PoS has produced 100+ block reorgs historically. Wait for ≥128 confirmations for financial finality, not just 1.
zkEVM and PoS are NOT the same chain; an asset on PoS is not available on zkEVM without explicit bridging. Check chainId at every contract boundary.
